caption: The drawing depicts a painted wooden statue of a figure dressed in a long, black cloak with areas of worn paint revealing patches of wood and lighter colors beneath. The figure has a visible face with neutral features and hands held together in a prayer position just below the chest. The face is rendered in tones of light brown and tan, with dark, arched eyebrows, and the eyes gaze forward. The cloak covers the head and falls straight down, mostly obscuring the figure’s form except for the hands. The interior of the cloak is a muted reddish-brown, with black cracks and signs of weathering or deterioration. The background of the image is blank, with a wash of pale beige or off-white, isolating the figure in the composition. The colors used are primarily black, brown, tan, and reddish-brown, with hints of white and gray where the paint is chipped or faded. There is a small inscription at the bottom right corner that reads "Hazel G. Chaplin - 1905."
title: Bulto (Virgin)
